summary: A DataTable of tasks grouped into collapsible sprints, with a resizable Task column, drag-to-reorder rows between groups and a button inside a cell.
use: Backlogs, boards in table form and any grouped list where rows are reordered or moved and cells hold controls.
spec: `groupBy={(t) => t.sprint}` renders one tbody per sprint with a header button that collapses its rows
`meta: { label: 'Task', resizable: true }` with `size: 320`, `minSize: 160` and `maxSize: 560` adds a keyboard and pointer resize handle
`{onReorder}` adds a grip per row; `rowId={(t) => t.id}` gives rows stable ids; the handler applies `e.to.group` and `e.to.index` to `tasks`
`renderComponent(Button, {` puts a Button in a cell; clicking it does not fire `onRowClick`
